title: Add a note to a permission Yes in the Claude pane
notes: Claude Code: Tab adds a note to a yes. Pane: a typed reason exists only on No (chat-permission.ts:55). Whether PermissionResult carries an allow note is unverified; if not, comment on the card and stop without a PR. Size S.

comments.body: Skipped: the SDK cannot carry a note on an allow. In @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.312, sdk.d.ts:2585 types PermissionResult allow as {behavior, updatedInput?, updatedPermissions?, toolUseID?, decisionClassification?}; only deny has message. The bundled CLI (claude-agent-sdk-linux-x64/claude) parses the SDK host answer with the same zod object (behavior: literal allow, updatedInput, updatedPermissions, toolUseID, decisionClassification), so an extra field is dropped. Claude Code's own Tab note on a yes is acceptFeedback, read only by its built-in permission dialog, not reachable from canUseTool. No PR opened. Revisit if a later SDK adds a message or feedback field to the allow result.
